title: Page 10
content_zh:
「什么花言巧语，我这可是在说实话。」他可没说谎，这的确是他发自内心真正的感受，不管她变成怎样，他对她的喜爱永远不会改变。
「少来了……」
「咳、咳、咳——」
凉亭里两人亲亲密密，凉亭外却有个男人非常刻意地咳出声来，就是要打断他们的卿卿我我。
樊若柳往外一看，立刻害羞地赶紧将黏着她不放的戚无秋推开。「无秋，是我哥哥……」
戚无秋只好照着她的意思赶紧松手，厚脸皮地笑着和樊如星打招呼。「大舅子，你好。」
「谁是你大舅子了，八字都还没一撇呢！」樊如星板着脸，对他们之间太过亲密的动作颇有不满。「光天化日之下的，你在对我妹妹做什么，规矩一点。」
自他陪着妹妹留在戚家养伤，戚无秋就开始对他猛献殷勤，还抬出大哥戚无双来和他商讨妹妹婚约的事，他才知道原来妹妹和戚无秋早已互相倾心，而他们又从妹妹口中知道孟承知对这个婚约的态度也不甚积极，转圜的机会不小，便打算先从他身上下手。
对于妹妹和戚无秋两人之间的情感，以及戚无秋无微不至的细心照顾，身为哥哥的樊如星是看得一清二楚，也明白妹妹是非戚无秋不嫁了，但是看到他们俩无所顾忌的亲亲密密，他还是感到有些火，非常的不是滋味。
妹妹能找到自己喜欢的好归宿，他做哥哥的当然是乐意也祝福她，但还是会忍不住感到有些失落，只好把一些闷气出在抢走他妹妹的男人身上了。
戚无秋还是继续厚着脸皮攀关系，反正现在他不习惯，叫久了也就会习惯的。「是是是，我下次一定注意的，请大舅子放心。」
「你……」他对戚无秋的厚脸皮还真是一点办法也没有，只能莫可奈何地摇摇头。「算了算了，我和戚大公子约着谈事情，你最好守分寸一点，别再乘机占我妹妹的便宜。」
他必须先和戚大公子商量好退婚需付出的诚意赔偿条件，之后才能正式去孟家提退婚的事情，这样成功的机会才大，而他们这两家的家长正忙碌着，这两个小辈倒是轻松惬意呀，看了就火大。
「遵命，大舅子。」戚无秋笑着说。
再听戚无秋大舅子长、大舅子短下去，他真会不习惯到全身起疙瘩，所以决定还是赶快离开，就不必再听了。
直到樊如星走远之后，戚无秋故意苦着一张脸对她说：「唉，你大哥要我守分寸一点，怎么办？」
佳人就在眼前，还逼他只能看，不能搂搂抱抱，这简直就是在折磨他呀！
「那……就换我占你便宜喽。」樊若柳原本的笑容中多了一抹俏皮神色，换她主动伸手勾住他的臂膀，好好地安抚他一番。
戚无秋原本沮丧的神色一振，精神又回来了。「你可以再多占我一些便宜，我一点都不会介意的。」
自从她恢复记忆之后，他发现她的个性变得不太一样了，少了些傻气，多了些俏皮，这应该才是她原本真正的性情。

不过不管她的性情如何改变，他对她的喜爱不减反增，总而言之，他这辈子就是认定她了。
「少得寸进尺了你……」看着他那万分期待的神色，她又好笑又羞涩地瞪了他一眼，才不想让他太过得意。
戚无秋还是不死心，继续怂恿道：「好啦，再多占我一点便宜，绝对不会吃亏的，来吧来吧……」
她被他那「垂涎」的神色逗得忍不住笑了出来。「呵呵……才不要，我才不会中你的计……」
「反正现在大舅子不在，不怕他骂人。」
「不行、不行，喂……你又开始不规矩了……」
凉爽的午后，一对有情人的欢笑声回荡在花园里，久久不曾停歇，像是在预告着幸福美满的未来即将到来，不再有任何悲哀伤痛。
笑声继续传递着，就像是要将他们俩此刻的幸福也传递出去般，让所有人都能感染到这一份快乐，扬起祝福的笑容……
樊若柳在戚家整整休养了一个月，手臂的伤才渐渐痊愈，终于能够像正常人一样地活动了。
等到樊若柳的伤全好了之后，她便和哥哥一起启程，打算去找孟承知，将所有事情做个了结，戚无秋当然是跟着他们一起出门了。
坐着马车，来到孟承知所在的县城里，戚无秋本来要跟着樊若柳他们一起当面见见孟承知，却被她给阻止了，他只好一个人坐在停在孟家门前的马车里，一颗心焦虑不安，简直难受到了极点。
樊若柳和樊如星这一次是来孟家商量取消婚约的事情，这对戚无秋来说非常重要，因此他忍不住地紧张，希望事情能够顺利解决。
但他们已经进去孟家有好一段时间，却迟迟没有出来，这让在马车上等待的戚无秋越来越焦虑，就怕孟家不肯放人，所以两方才僵持不下，谈到现在还没有任何结果。
如果真是这样，那他到底该怎么办？
「啊啊啊……真是急死人了！」待在马车上快待不下去，他烦躁地吼叫出声，最后干脆走下车，在人家的大门前来回踱步，踱完一遍又一遍，简直没完没了。
「不行，我得赶紧想个办法，如果孟家真的不答应解除婚约的话，就别怪我手下不留情，逼得他们一定得……」
「无秋。」
「呃？」他烦躁的脚步一顿，这才发现樊若柳和樊如星终于从孟家大门走出来了，他赶紧来到她的面前，非常担心结果到底是如何。「孟家的人怎么说？他们答应解除婚约了吗？」
「你们两个自己谈吧！」樊如星先行至马车上，让小俩口自己说去。
「这……」她有些欲言又止，柳眉微微皱起，看起来商量的结果似乎非常不好。

这让戚无秋的心紧紧一缩，恨不得马上杀进门去，用拳头让孟家不得不点头，答应解除两人之间的婚约。「你别担心，换我进去和他们谈，我就不信他们——」
「啊，等等，别冲动！」樊若柳赶紧抓住冲动的他，别让他真的闯了进去。「我话都还没说完，你也先听我把话说完嘛。」
「看你的表情，我也知道结果是什么，他们一定是……」
「他们答应了。」她立即回答。
「他……嗄？」他一脸错愕。「你说什么？」
「我说，孟家已经答应解除婚约了。」她俏皮地一笑，她只是想要小小吊他一下胃口，没想到他的反应这么激动，差点就真的要冲进去了。
「你是说真的？」他还是有些不敢置信。
「当然是真的。」
孟承知本来就只把樊若柳当妹妹看，对她没有男女之情，所以就算两人有婚约，他也迟迟没有完婚的打算，一听到樊家想要解除婚约，他当然点头说好，让樊若柳能够和真正所爱的人在一起。
所以最大的问题就是说服孟家父母也同意放弃这门亲事，樊如星已经和大公子戚无双商量过，只要孟家愿意取消婚约，戚家可以帮助孟家扩展他们酒庄的事业，当作是对孟家的补偿。
孟家二老想了想，反正自己的儿子也没有那个意愿，退了婚自家又有利益可取，没有考虑太久，也就答应了。
「是真的……是真的……哇哈哈，这简直是太好了！」戚无秋紧张的心情瞬间一松，开心地紧紧抱住樊若柳，才不管这里是不是人来人往的大街上，才不管大舅子会不会不高兴，他就是想抱住她，和她一起分享自己的喜悦，让她也感受到他的快乐。
content_en:
"What rhetoric, I'm telling the truth." He wasn't lying. This was indeed his true feeling from the bottom of his heart. No matter what she became, his love for her would never change.
"Don't come here..."
"Cough, cough, cough——"
The two of them were intimate in the pavilion, but outside the pavilion there was a man who coughed very deliberately, just to interrupt their intimacy.
Fan Ruoliu looked outside and immediately shyly pushed Qi Wuqiu away who was clinging to her. "Wuqiu, it's my brother..."
Qi Wuqiu had no choice but to let go as she wanted and greeted Fan Ruxing with a cheeky smile. "Hello, brother-in-law."
"Who is your brother-in-law? He hasn't even revealed his horoscope yet!" Fan Ruxing said with a straight face, quite dissatisfied with the too close gestures between them. "What are you doing to my sister in broad daylight? Behave yourself."
Ever since he stayed with his sister at Qi's house to recuperate, Qi Wuqiu had begun to be very courteous to him, and even brought his eldest brother Qi Wushuang to discuss his sister's engagement with him. Only then did he realize that his sister and Qi Wuqiu had already fallen in love with each other, and they also learned from their sister that Meng Chengzhi's attitude towards the engagement was not very positive, and the chance of changing the situation was not small, so they planned to start with him first.
As for the relationship between his sister and Qi Wuqiu, as well as Qi Wuqiu's meticulous care, Fan Ruxing, as the elder brother, saw clearly, and he also understood that his sister was right and Qi Wuqiu did not want to marry. However, seeing the two of them being intimate and unscrupulous, he still felt a little angry, which was very unpleasant.
Of course, his brother would be happy and bless her that her sister could find a good home that she likes, but he still couldn't help but feel a little disappointed, so he had to take out some of his sullenness on the man who took his sister away.
Qi Wuqiu continued to have a relationship shamelessly. Anyway, he was not used to it now, and he would get used to it after being called for a long time. "Yes, yes, I will definitely pay attention to it next time, please don't worry, brother-in-law."
"You..." He really had nothing to do with Qi Wuqiu's shamelessness, so he could only shake his head helplessly. "Forget it, Mr. Qi and I have an appointment to discuss something. You'd better be more sensible and don't take advantage of my sister again."
He must first discuss with Mr. Qi the sincere compensation conditions for breaking off the engagement, and then he can formally go to the Meng family to propose breaking off the engagement. This will have a greater chance of success. While the parents of the two families are busy, the two juniors are relaxed and comfortable, and they get angry when they see it.
"As you command, brother-in-law." Qi Wuqiu said with a smile.
If he heard that Qi Wuqiu's brother-in-law was older and his brother-in-law was younger, he would really get used to it and get lumps all over his body, so he decided to leave as soon as possible so that he didn't have to listen to it anymore.
It wasn't until Fan Ruxing walked away that Qi Wuqiu deliberately said to her with a bitter look on his face: "Hey, your elder brother wants me to be more conservative, what should I do?"
The beautiful woman is right in front of him, but he is forced to look at her and not hug her. This is simply torturing him!
"Then... let me take advantage of you." Fan Ruoliu's original smile had a playful look, so she took the initiative to reach out and hook his arm to comfort him.
Qi Wuqiu's originally depressed expression lifted, and his energy returned. "You can take advantage of me a little more, I won't mind at all."
Since she regained her memory, he found that her personality has become different, less silly and more playful. This should be her true temperament.
But no matter how her temperament changed, his love for her only increased instead of decreasing. In short, he recognized her for the rest of his life.
"You're trying too hard..." Looking at his expectant look, she glared at him funny and shy, not wanting him to be too proud.
Qi Wuqiu still refused to give up and continued to encourage: "Okay, if you take advantage of me a little more, you will definitely not suffer a loss. Come on, come on..."
She was "coveted" by himHe looked so amused that he couldn't help but laugh. "Haha... I don't want to, I won't fall into your trap..."
"Anyway, my brother-in-law is not here now, so I'm not afraid of him scolding me."
"No, no, hey... you're acting unruly again..."
In the cool afternoon, the laughter of a pair of lovers echoed in the garden without stopping for a long time, as if it was foretelling that a happy future is coming, and there will be no more sorrow and pain.
The laughter continues to spread, as if to spread the happiness of the two of them at this moment, so that everyone can be infected with this happiness and raise a blessing smile...
Fan Ruoliu rested at Qi's house for a full month before the injury on his arm gradually healed and he was finally able to move like a normal person.
After Fan Ruoliu's injuries were completely healed, she set off with her brother, planning to find Meng Chengzhi and settle everything. Of course Qi Wuqiu went out with them.
Taking a carriage, they arrived at the county town where Meng Chengzhi was located. Qi Wuqiu was originally going to meet Meng Chengzhi in person with Fan Ruoliu and the others, but she stopped him. He had to sit alone in the carriage parked in front of Meng's house, feeling anxious and extremely uncomfortable.
Fan Ruoliu and Fan Ruxing came to Meng's house to discuss the cancellation of the engagement this time. This was very important to Qi Wuqiu, so he couldn't help but feel nervous, hoping that the matter could be resolved smoothly.
But they had been in the Meng family for a long time, but they had not come out. This made Qi Wuqiu, who was waiting on the carriage, more and more anxious, fearing that the Meng family would not let them go, so the two sides were in a stalemate, and there was no result yet.
If this is the case, what on earth should he do?
"Ahhhh... I'm so anxious!" He couldn't stay in the carriage any longer, so he yelled irritably. Finally, he simply got out of the car and paced back and forth in front of the door of the house, over and over again, endlessly.
"No, I have to think of a way quickly. If the Meng family really doesn't agree to terminate the engagement, don't blame me for being ruthless and forcing them to..."
"No autumn."
"Huh?" He paused irritably, and then he realized that Fan Ruoliu and Fan Ruxing had finally walked out of the Meng family gate. He hurried to her, very worried about what the outcome would be. "What do the Meng family say? Have they agreed to terminate the engagement?"
"You two can talk among yourselves!" Fan Ruxing walked to the carriage first and let the young couple talk on their own.
"This..." She hesitated, her eyebrows slightly wrinkled, and it seemed that the outcome of the discussion was very bad.
This made Qi Wuqiu's heart shrink tightly, and he wanted to rush in immediately and use his fists to make the Meng family nod and agree to terminate the engagement between the two. "Don't worry, if I go in and talk to them, I won't believe them—"
"Ah, wait, don't be impulsive!" Fan Ruoliu quickly caught the impulsive man to prevent him from really breaking in. "I haven't finished speaking yet. You should listen to me finish speaking first."
"Looking at your expression, I also know what the result will be. They must be..."
"They said yes," she replied immediately.
"He... Huh?" He looked stunned. "What did you say?"
"I said, the Meng family has agreed to terminate the engagement." She smiled playfully. She just wanted to whet his appetite a little, but she didn't expect his reaction to be so excited that she almost rushed in.
"Are you serious?" He still couldn't believe it.
"Of course it's true."
Meng Chengzhi originally only regarded Fan Ruoliu as his sister and had no feelings for her, so even if the two were engaged, he had no plans to consummate the marriage. When he heard that the Fan family wanted to terminate the engagement, he of course nodded and agreed to let Fan Ruoliu be with the person he truly loved.
So the biggest problem is to persuade the Meng family's parents to agree to give up this marriage. Fan Ruxing has already discussed it with the eldest son Qi Wushuang. As long as the Meng family is willingIf they want to cancel the engagement, the Qi family can help the Meng family expand their winery business as compensation to the Meng family.
The two elders of the Meng family thought for a while and realized that their son didn't have that intention anyway, and his family would benefit from breaking off the engagement, so he agreed without thinking for too long.
"It's true... it's true... Wow haha, this is so good!" Qi Wuqiu's nervousness instantly relaxed, and he happily hugged Fan Ruoliu tightly. He didn't care if this was a busy street, or whether his brother-in-law would be unhappy. He just wanted to hug her, share his joy with her, and let her feel his happiness.
